apps.title: Simple User Registry
apps.description: Smallest useful NPDev sample. Shows concept, invariants, persistence, event emission, and trace visibility.
learningGoals: Observe invariant enforcement in a simple form submission
See persistence and event emission in one flow
expectedOutcomes: Execution trace and timeline are available for inspection
nextExperiments: Try submitting a duplicate or invalid email payload
Add a new optional field in later authoring steps
Inspect the trace after a valid execution

apps.title: Simple Contact Intake
apps.description: Adds notification capability to the basic pattern and shows how an external-style side effect can still be governed semantically.
learningGoals: Understand a slightly richer simple app than user registry
See capability invocation in a beginner-friendly scenario
Observe event and notification behavior together
expectedOutcomes: An event is emitted and trace evidence is available
nextExperiments: Try changing required fields later in visual authoring
Compare this flow with simple-user-registry to see capability growth

apps.title: Medium Expense Approval
apps.description: The first official medium sample. Demonstrates await-event, branching, persistence, notification, webhook behavior, and resumable orchestration.
learningGoals: Understand that NPDev supports waiting and resuming business processes
See branching based on later external input
Observe how one semantic process can include persistence plus multiple capabilities
expectedOutcomes: Expense submission starts and persists the business record
The flow waits for a later approval-style event
After the event, the flow resumes and follows the correct branch
nextExperiments: Submit an expense and inspect the waiting state
Publish the approval event using the returned correlation id
Compare the trace before and after resume
